description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDependentService class within the OrangeHRM application, providing methods for managing employee dependents, such as retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching dependents tied to employee records.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentService
classes.description: Service layer class that manages operations related to employee dependents, including retrieval, update, deletion, and search functionalities, utilizing the EmployeeDependentDao data access object.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependentDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the EmployeeDependentDao instance used for data operations.

methods.name: setEmployeeDependentDao
methods.description: Sets or replaces the EmployeeDependentDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of dependents associated with a specific employee identified by $empNumber.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dependent record for an employee based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: saveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Persists a given EmpDependent entity, either creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Deletes specified dependents for an employee based on provided entries.

methods.name: searchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Performs a search for dependents based on filter parameters, throwing ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of dependents matching search filter criteria, throwing ServiceException on failure.
